summary: The State of Wyoming, Executive Department submitted the first response to the draft ORV environmental statement, dated June 12, 1972, and was assigned response number '1' in the appendix. The document only notes the existence and filing order of this response without describing its content or position. No substantive stance or opinion from Wyoming is summarized in the available text.
